answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 12014 Country: United Kingdom Title: Salam MY WIFE GOT A DRIVING TEST IS ANY DUA SHE COULD READ TO PASS FIRST TIME. I GOT WEAK MEMORY IMPROVE MY MEMORY. AND IS AND DUA FOR STOP FROM HEART ATTACK? Question: Salam MY WIFE GOT A DRIVING TEST IS ANY DUA SHE COULD READ TO PASS FIRST TIME. I GOT WEAK MEMORY IMPROVE MY MEMORY. AND IS AND DUA FOR STOP FROM HEART ATTACK? Answer ID: 12014 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 615/445=L/1430) (1) It is not liked by Shariah for women to drive. (2) For improving memory, you should recite ya Qawi ( يا قوي ) 11 times after every salah. (3) After every salah, recite Surah Alam Nashrah 7 times and blow on your chest. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
